Portfolio.description: Hand-coded, framework-free portfolio: interactive neural-network hero, live project visuals, a terminal and a ⌘K menu. Hosted free on GitHub Pages.

community-crisis-predictor.description: Forecasts community mental-health crises on Reddit a week ahead: LSTM + XGBoost over sentiment, distress lexicons and BERTopic drift, with SHAP and LLM weekly briefs.

AI-Web-Page-Summarizer.description: Chrome extension that summarizes and chats with any web page, including PDFs, images (OCR) and YouTube, grounded by RAG with live web search.

JurisTrack.description: Geo-compliance radar: flags region-specific legal risk (EU DSA, CCPA, Utah, Florida, NCMEC) in feature specs with explainable LLM reasoning and a risk score.

Misarticulation-Project.description: LingoLeap: gamified speech-therapy web app that helps Hindi-speaking children with misarticulation practise pronunciation using speech recognition.

Movie-Recommendation-System.description: Content-based movie recommender on TMDB 5000: stemmed tags, CountVectorizer and cosine similarity, served in a Streamlit app with TMDB posters.

SMS-Spam-Classifier.description: NLP model that flags spam text messages, trained on the UCI SMS Spam Collection and served with Streamlit.

Fitness-Tracker-API.description: MERN workout tracker: create users, log exercises with duration and date, and edit or delete them through a REST API.

Hospital-Management-System.description: HappyHealers: responsive hospital website with online appointment booking, built on Express, Handlebars and MongoDB.

Tourist-Places-Management-System.description: Flask web app for exploring tourist destinations, with a contact form stored in SQLite through SQLAlchemy.

Matrimonial-Website.description: PerfectPartner: matrimonial website with hashed-password registration and login, built on PHP and MySQL.

Data-Structures.description: Classic data structures implemented from scratch in C++ with detailed comments, from beginner to advanced. Starts with linked lists.

RayaanQ.description: ✦ My GitHub profile: animated SVGs generated by this repo, refreshed daily by GitHub Actions.
